The '''SoapBox mining pool''' is the ecosystem's mining pool, published at pool.soapbox.community.

== Function ==
The pool serves the Etchash proof-of-work of the [[PRANA Blockchain|PRANA]] chain and additional CryptoNote-family chains. It offers browser-based mining alongside conventional miner connections, and includes in-browser wallet generation so a participant can begin without installing separate software.
